scope: Independent static review of root's stable owned-Bot run-end lifecycle fixture repair; no test execution
conclusion: No static blocker; actual PG regression remains separately owned by root

findings.subject: Issue scope
findings.result: Factory issue authority uses owner or workspace/scopeVersion; locked projection has no issue.botId. Extra issues.botId mutation is unnecessary.

findings.subject: Source scope
findings.result: Explicit source botId matches the existing owned cloudBotId and explicit issueId matches the route. The same original source guard now also verifies the Bot owner. No authorization predicate is removed.

findings.subject: Run consistency
findings.result: The pre-existing queue callback writes the store-supplied Bot to agent_runs; dispatch already enforces matching task/run Bot or original owned-workspace cloud mapping. Added in-memory task.botId assertion checks intended fixed identity without new SQL.

findings.subject: Cloud fixture state
findings.result: Same workspace and Bot INSERTs moved earlier, not duplicated. No parent machine/provider/snapshot creation is added; existing machine state setup, queuedCloudTask and computer_run_bindings remain unchanged.

findings.subject: BE18 earlier attempt
findings.result: Original synthetic origin run and its NULL Bot remain unchanged. Chain ownership is same user+issue; no new Bot condition is imposed on this separate continuation case.

findings.subject: Conservation
findings.result: Reversing only moved block/comment, store argument, source INSERT and new assertion restores the full original test byte-for-byte. All original cases and73 assertions preserved; one new assertion. Only this tracked file changed relative to d683.

findings.subject: Race coverage boundary
findings.result: The lifecycle fixture now uses a stable owned Bot instead of participating in legacy NULL-Bot adoption. Product backfill/allowedSource stays intact. Source establishes the race can occur, but CI did not directly trace the original failed row transition.

validationBoundary.sourceOnlyStatementCount: The two setup INSERTs were moved, not added. Event INSERT gains explicit fields; test wire bytes were not measured.
validationBoundary.remaining: Root's one original full DB test-file run must supply actual regression result; no peer duplicate run.
